description.value: An unlocked, open-access wilderness shelter near Squamish operated by the 99 Trials Association, a non-profit motorcycle trials club advocating for trails throughout the Sea to Sky corridor. The one-storey wood cabin sits at 467m elevation and offers basic refuge with a fireplace, but no running water, toilets, mattresses, or shower facilities. No reservation is required and the door is never locked, making it available on demand to anyone who reaches it.
